newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-SCHALKE LOSE STRIKERS FOR UEFA CUP SEMIFINAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SCHALKE LOSE STRIKERS FOR UEFA CUP SEMIFINAL.

text.p: Schalke strikers Martin Max und Youri Mulder were both ruled out of Tuesday's UEFA Cup semifinal against Tenerife after picking up serious injuries in the German league on Saturday.
Max and Dutchman Mulder were hurt in Schalke's goalless draw at Karlsruhe and went to hospital with suspected ligament injuries.
Club officials said they would definitely miss the game in Tenerife.
